Build SPARQL Query for Class Retrieval

Source: R/get_wikidata_instances.R
dot-build_sparql_query.Rd

Internal helper that builds a SPARQL query for retrieving items by `instance of` or `subclass of` with an optional country filter.

Usage

.build_sparql_query(
  class_qid,
  country = NULL,
  property_id = "P31",
  limit = 1000
)

Arguments

class_qid

Character class QID.

country

Optional character country QID.

property_id

Character. A Wikidata property ID (e.g. `"P31"`, `"P279"`, `"P39"`).

limit

Integer result limit.

Value

A character SPARQL query string.
